PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/brick#ref>
SELECT ?z ?s WHERE {
  ?z a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER(?l IN ("Perimeter_top_ZN_1","Perimeter_top_ZN_4"))
  ?z brick:hasPoint ?p .
  ?p a brick:SpaceOccupancy .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?s .
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT ?zone ?point ?tsref WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER(?l IN ("Perimeter_top_ZN_1","Perimeter_top_ZN_4"))
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a brick:Occupancy_Sensor .
  ?point brick:ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref>
SELECT ?zone ?point ?tsref WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER(?l IN ("Perimeter_top_ZN_1","Perimeter_top_ZN_4"))
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
}

SELECT ?subject ?pred ?tsref WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER(?l IN ("Perimeter_top_ZN_1","Perimeter_top_ZN_4"))
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point ?pred ?tsref .
  FILTER(?pred != brick:isPointOf && ?pred != rdf:type)
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref>
SELECT ?point ?tsref ?pointclass WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER(?l IN ("Perimeter_top_ZN_1","Perimeter_top_ZN_4"))
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a ?pointclass .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref>
SELECT ?point ?tsref WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER(?l = "Perimeter_top_ZN_1")
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
}
